topic: A personal root that would hold an open org's private repo
detail: Setup gives a Personal or Job group a folder root only when that folder would not take another job's checkout or an open org's private repo out of quarantine. On a typical layout (personal and open-source checkouts side by side in ~/code with one private open-org repo) personal therefore gets no root: its checkouts are placed by their GitHub owner, and non-git folders under ~/code go to quarantine. Options: (a) keep this, so the private open-org repo stays in quarantine (what SP-052.1 a1 asks); (b) bind ~/code to personal anyway, sending that repo to personal; (c) offer a narrower root per checkout. Recommendation: (a), with (c) in the advanced editor (SP-053).
